uncertain: No dimension is printed on the room plans and no section is published: side lengths come from the plot plan (1802 x 1780) and were checked against the plan scale derived from the printed garage area; ridge and floor levels are not printed.

The elevations are renders with a slight perspective (the left wing measures 836 px on the LEFT picture and 817 px in the background of the RIGHT picture); positions of things in far planes can be 1-3 % off.

Gable glazings: each gable has one glazed field divided by a centre post/pier (a real pier on the ground floor of the living block per the plan, the party wall of two rooms in the attic of the left wing). They are given as two openings per level; reading each gable field as ONE opening (or the living-block gable + ground glazing as one two-storey glazing) is defensible.
Level of F10, F11, B3, B4: at attic height but lighting the double-height living block (the attic plan says void above the living room): level 0 by the format rule, level 1 by height.
Kinds: floor-reaching glazings on terraces/balconies are GLAZED_DOOR although only some leaves open; F8/F9/R1 could be called WINDOW.
F1 garage door: width differs between the picture (about 4.7 m) and the room plan (about 4.1 m); its top edge is in deep shadow (+-10 px).
A glazing of the living room faces the inner courtyard to the left (plan) and a roof window of the left wing faces right (plot plan): neither can be seen on any elevation, so they are not listed.
Chimney count 2 = one masonry chimney + one steel fireplace flue; someone may count only the masonry one.
Which body is MAIN: the taller two-storey left wing was taken; the living block is WING.
